module: Flowgraph node "Mission Attempt Stars" (category once_instant, tags activity/mission). Adds stars to an attempt "via the constructor": the custom input pins are gathered into a table and passed to mission:addAttemptData(attempt, data), leaving it to the mission type to fill unlockedStars. Fixed input and output "attempt" (attemptData).
notes: Crashes without an associated activity (self.mgr.activity nil is indexed). If addAttemptData does not exist, the attempt is returned as is (with unlockedStars = {} at minimum).

workOnce.desc: Initializes attempt.unlockedStars, collects the custom pins, calls activity:addAttemptData if present, then outputs attempt.
